![kody code-review](https://img.shields.io/badge/kody-code--review-312B4B?labelColor=C9BBF2) ![Bug](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bug-B71C1C) ![high](https://img.shields.io/badge/severity_level-high-6B6B92)


`expect_launchd` is reduced to the legacy `com.jay.botfleet-server` label and the loop probes only that one label (line 520), dropping the removed alias handling for the `app.botfleet.server` rename and the `botfleet_update_in_progress` guard. On a Mac already running the renamed label, `launchctl print gui/$uid/com.jay.botfleet-server` fails on every 120-second tick, so the watcher reports a permanent false DOWN and will bootstrap a second harness on :8799 in the middle of a BotFleet update — the 2026-10-01 incident the removed comment documented. Restore the alias list and the update-lock check, e.g. keep the spec as `"app.botfleet.server app.botfleet.server.plist com.jay.botfleet-server"` and skip the bootstrap when `botfleet_update_in_progress` returns 0.

```shell
expect_launchd=(
  "com.jay.claude-remote-control com.jay.claude-remote-control.plist"
  "com.jay.slack-agent-inbox com.jay.slack-agent-inbox.plist"
  "app.botfleet.server app.botfleet.server.plist com.jay.botfleet-server"
)
```
